treats qwords `rcx+0`, `+8` and `+0x10` as begin, end and limit of 0x230-byte elements; when end differs from limit, it adds 0x230 to `r8` if `r8` lies in [`rdx`, end) (unsigned), calls `001C2790` + 0x5B (end, end-0x230) when end is non-null, then `001C2790` + 0x6F (`rdx`, end-0x230, end) and `001C2790` + 0x7A (`rdx`, `r8`), and adds 0x230 to `+8`; otherwise it sets a capacity of 1 when the 32-bit count (end-begin)/0x230 is 0, else twice the count (a null buffer, without allocating, when that is 0), allocates capacity times 0x230 through vtable slot `+0x10` of the object at `rcx+0x18`, calls `001C2790` + 0xF6 (stack slot, begin, `rdx`, buffer), then `001C2790` + 0x118 with the qword it leaves in the slot and `r8` when that is non-null, then `001C2790` + 0x13F (slot, `rdx`, end, that qword+0x230), calls `001C2790` + 0x167 on `+0x108` of each old element, frees a non-null old begin through vtable slot `+0x18` with (limit-begin)/0x230 times 0x230 bytes, and stores the buffer, the qword the second call leaves in the slot and buffer plus capacity times 0x230 to `+0`, `+8` and `+0x10`
